title: The 8 Best Brad Nailer 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for brad nailer 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at brad nailer 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: DEWALT 20V MAX XR 18 Gauge Cordless Brad Nailer (DCN680B), Tool Only
products.blurb: Key specs: 20V Max battery, 18-gauge, Tool-free depth adjust.
strengths: Cordless 20V Max -- no hose drag for trim work throughout a house or shop
Dry-fire lockout prevents the tool from operating when the magazine is empty
Tool-free depth adjustment for different material hardness
The most recommended cordless brad nailer by finish carpenters and woodworkers
limitations: Bare tool only -- requires 20V Max battery purchased separately or as a kit
Battery weight adds heft vs a pneumatic nailer
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: BOSTITCH Brad Nailer Kit, 18GA, Smart Point, Pneumatic (BTFP12233)
products.blurb: Key specs: Smart Point nose, 18-gauge, Sequential fire.
strengths: Smart Point narrow nose provides the best visibility of any nose design
No deflector plate on the nose -- the brad fires directly from the narrow tip
Oil-free operation eliminates the compressor oil maintenance requirement
Sequential fire mode only -- prevents accidental bump firing

products.name: Milwaukee 2746-20 M18 FUEL 18 Gauge Brad Nailer (Tool Only)
products.blurb: Key specs: M18 battery, 18-gauge, FUEL motor.
strengths: Milwaukee FUEL brushless motor provides the most consistent drive power of any cordless nailer
M18 battery ecosystem for Milwaukee tool users
Tool-free jam clearing -- rotate the nose to access and clear a jammed brad
The most recommended Milwaukee cordless nailer by finish carpenters
limitations: Bare tool only -- requires M18 battery

products.name: RYOBI ONE+ 18V 18-Gauge Cordless AirStrike Brad Nailer (Tool Only)
products.blurb: Key specs: One+ 18V battery, 18-gauge, Budget price.
strengths: The lowest price cordless brad nailer from a major brand
Ryobi One+ compatibility -- works with all One+ 18V batteries
Tool-free depth adjustment
The correct starter cordless nailer for woodworkers on a budget
limitations: Less driving power than DeWalt FUEL or Milwaukee FUEL motors
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: Makita XNB01Z 18V LXT Lithium-Ion Cordless 2" Brad Nailer (Tool Only)
strengths: Makita 18V LXT battery ecosystem
Spring-loaded drive mechanism is different from the pneumatic-actuated designs of other brands
The fastest cycling cordless brad nailer-- drives faster than any competitor
The correct nailer for Makita LXT tool users
